dedupe_keys.name: tjekditnet dk broadband and mobile coverage by address municipality and region denmark

description: Tjekditnet.dk is the Danish Agency for Digital Government's public site for broadband and mobile coverage. Based on the agency's annual broadband mapping, it lets users zoom to a region, municipality or address and see what broadband speed and which technologies, such as copper, cable TV or fibre, are available; see coverage for homes, business addresses and summer houses; find the providers at an address; compare key coverage figures between regions and municipalities; measure their own connection speed; and extract data on mobile and broadband coverage. The agency presents it as a tool for active consumers, for municipalities planning local action on coverage, and for the telecom industry planning roll-out. Coverage: Denmark. Format and access: free web application with data extraction; the application refused automated requests (HTTP 401), so formats could not be checked. Caveats: coverage is reported by providers; details on download formats and update dates come from the agency's description page only. Simulation uses: address-level exposure of households and businesses to loss of broadband, identification of areas with only one technology, and planning of resilient connections. Related records: Mastedatabasen gives antenna positions, and the Danish telecom statistics give national subscription and investment figures.
